name: echo curious
description: Proposal, a mood for the idle rotation on the 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x): a small twinkling spark, a cream core with gold glints, drifts in from the left, arcs up over the head and down to hover beside the right shoulder, and the creature follows it with everything it has, the eyes sliding along the band and riding high while it is overhead, the head and body tilting toward it up to 6 degrees from the waist, the antenna curving after it left and then right; a forearm comes out of the right arm stub, the fist closes on it and it pops into eight gold rays that scatter into specks while the eyes go to happy arches, the antenna pings and the head comes upright; judge whether the tilt reads as a head tilt rather than a lean or a glitch, whether the eyes and antenna read as tracking, and whether it is still this creature.
